🔗 Google Sheets Integration
Connected!
ℹ️ How to: Make sure your sheet has a Brandlist tab with columns: Nama Brand, MID, Brand_Display, Brand_masking. Optionally add an Email CC tab with columns "Campaign Type" and "Email CC" (comma-separated) to auto-fill CC when sending emails. Share the sheet with "Anyone with the link" view access.
